The artifact now states seven invariants and seven negative classes, but its evidence ownership is not closed: EE-1, EE-2, and EE-5 expressly leave conditional or future design; EE-3 assigns the whole P-2 authority surface to DR-133 although that row's recorded provider-only contract covers component output/findings rather than persistence, rendering, termination, lifecycle, or generic imperative contribution; EE-6 assigns analyze network/egress evidence to DR-G01..G05, whose live gates measure size, install inventory, help/version startup, memory, and component cost; and EE-7 assigns a compound install/role/substrate/anti-lockstep class to DR-G14 even though that gate covers only self-contained TypeScript runtime/tool closure and the recorded independent-release evidence is at DR-121/DR-G16. A limb pointer to that section cannot answer the live cell's enforcement-evidence limb. DR-117 remains OPEN and this verdict authorizes nothing.

blockers.title: The enforcement-evidence limb still has unresolved and false ownership mappings, so PPBSV1-B1 is not repaired
blockers.measurement: The new section has seven item-numbered invariants and seven negativeClass strings, but it is not the closed evidence map its status and cellAnswer claim. EE-1 says 'Named remaining design if no existing harness specifies' without deciding whether one does; EE-2 and EE-5 say design remains until a harness is recorded. EE-3 routes the full P-2 role-authority class to host admission / DR-133, while the D-136-recorded provider-only-output-contract.v3 specifies provider-output refusal for facts/Coverage/findings/policy/admission and does not own the full persistence/rendering/termination/host-lifecycle or imperative-contribution surface. EE-5's negative class tests only a project hook, root command, or contribution-granted probe, leaving a generic imperative contribution not claiming one of those forms untested. EE-6 says existing offline/egress measurement is at DR-G01..G05. The live gate rows define those five as core download bytes, installed closure/TCB, help/version startup, baseline memory, and component cost; none exercises a PlanIntent network request or component/host-broker undeclared egress during analyze. EE-7 places all four fail cases under DR-119/DR-G14 plus D-002, but live DR-G14 exercises self-contained TypeScript runtime/tool closure and ambient/implicit-download refusal only. TypeScript role selection/evidence is DR-118/DR-G13, while independent release is DR-121/DR-G16; D-124's recorded monorepo-ci-contract.v16 already specifies IR-1..IR-4 and G16-12 against lockstep. The candidate neither maps nor distinguishes the useful-install inventory, core-only boundary, second-role refusal, Rust-sidecar retention, and anti-lockstep evidence owners.
blockers.governingConflict: The live DR-117 acceptance cell is 'Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3 with enforcement evidence'. D-056's five-gate property, reaffirmed as a property by D-133, permits a later Class-A split only when the accepted design has no express reservation, every remaining acceptance member is execution/fixture execution/qualification measurement rather than missing design or harness authoring, and every such remainder is already named at an owning condition-4/DR-G obligation. The subject itself says three classes still need design or a recorded harness and points two others at gates that do not own the asserted pass property. Its doesNot refusal to open Class A is honest but does not turn those gaps into an answer to CELL-2. This is the same design-versus-execution distinction PPBSV1-B1 made load-bearing.
counterexamples: A first-party trusted analyzer opens an undeclared socket during analyze without presenting a network-granted PlanIntent or host-broker request. Its manifest/admission class can pass, and DR-G01..G05 can all pass because none of those five gates observes analyze egress.

A release system can emit the selected TypeScript closure only on the same version train as the core. DR-G14 can pass its signed self-contained/offline runtime closure while the candidate's no-lockstep invariant fails; the discriminating IR-1/IR-2 evidence actually lives at the D-124-recorded DR-121/DR-G16 contract the subject omits.

A contributor claims an imperative action beneath an allowed declarative subcommand without claiming a root command, project hook, probe, policy, persistence, rendering, termination, or host-lifecycle authority. EE-3 and EE-5's named negative inputs both miss it even though item 5 excludes imperative contributions as a class.
A release admits a second preview language role while still shipping a self-contained TypeScript closure. DR-G14 passes; the missing DR-118/DR-G13 role-set check is what would fail.
blockers.whyBlocker: Enforcement evidence is one of the live cell's two explicit limbs and item 4's full source identity includes it. This is not a request to execute any harness now. It is a requirement that the candidate define the complete falsification surface and resolve each class to the correct existing owner, or identify a concrete missing-design owner without claiming the limb answered. Conditional phrases, subsystem labels such as 'host admission', and gates whose live definitions test unrelated quantities do not make later execution mechanical or attributable. Accepting this revision would certify v1's central blocker as landed while the artifact's own bytes still reserve design and misroute test ownership.
blockers.requiredRepair: In a successor, retain the repaired lineage, full item-4 name, DR-128/non-sandbox split, and host-owned doctor distinction. Replace each conditional 'if/until a harness' statement with a determinate result from the live corpus. For every item and every compound sub-limb, give a constructible input, an exact pass/refusal property, the accountable row plus exact DR-G/harness where one exists, and an execution-only standing; if no existing owner actually covers it, identify the concrete missing-design owner and do not claim CELL-2 answered or status 'specified-classes-not-executed' until that design lands. In particular: route or author an analyze-specific offline/egress denial test instead of DR-G01..G05; split item 7 across the useful-install/core inventory owner, DR-118/DR-G13 role selection, the Rust-sidecar deferral owner, DR-131 pack identity, and DR-121/DR-G16's recorded IR-1..IR-4 anti-lockstep evidence; and cover generic imperative contribution plus every P-2 authority form at its actual admission/result boundary. Keep all evidence unexecuted/not QUALIFIED, do not mark DR-117 SATISFIED, and do not authorize implementation.
